October 2026 Community Development Commission Hearing

The Oct. 13 meeting of the Community Development Commission will be held at 1:30 p.m. in Room 1103 at City Hall, 121 N. LaSalle St.

A livestream will be available to watch the day of the meeting.

Address (TIF Project Area, Ward) Agenda Description Materials

1207 W. Leland Ave.
Lawrence/Broadway Redevelopment Project Area
(46th Ward)

 Request for the Commission to grant authority to the Department of Housing to negotiate a redevelopment agreement with Mercy Housing Lakefront for the redevelopment of the property located at 1207 W. Leland Ave. in the Lawrence/Broadway Redevelopment Project Area, and for the Commission to recommend to the City Council the designation of Mercy Housing Lakefront as Developer. Staff Report

758 E. 111th St.
North Pullman Redevelopment Project Area
(9th Ward)

 Request for the Commission to grant authority to the Department of Planning and Development to negotiate a redevelopment agreement with Chicago Neighborhood Initiatives for the redevelopment of the property located at 758 E. 111th St. in the North Pullman Redevelopment Project Area, and for the Commission to recommend to the City Council the designation of Chicago Neighborhood Initiatives as Developer. Staff Report
